business_summary.text: D.P. Abhushan Limited, a jewellery retailer under the "D.P. Jewellers" brand, has expanded its retail network to 14 showrooms with the inauguration of its first FOCO (Franchisee Owned Company Operated) showroom in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. This pilot model aims to facilitate expansion with lower capital deployment while maintaining operational control.

call_points.text: Management targets 20% to 25% revenue growth for FY27, aiming for ₹4,800 Cr.
EBITDA margin is expected to normalize around 6% to 6.5% for FY27.

timeline.summary: D. P. Abhushan announced the launch of its official e-commerce website www.dpjewellers.com for online jewellery sales on May 10, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,334.73 Cr, net profit ₹50.6 Cr.
D. P. Abhushan reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,070 Cr and PAT of ₹212 Cr.
D. P. Abhushan reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,338.9 Cr and PAT of ₹50.6 Cr.
D.P. Abhushan issued a corrigendum to its EGM notice to substitute certain allottees for its proposed preferential issue.
D.P. Abhushan inaugurated its first FOCO showroom in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, expanding its retail network to 14 outlets
